mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO cinema_directory (poi_id, name, brand, province, city, district, address, phone, source) VALUES (#{poiId}, #{name}, #{brand}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{source})
